# MAME src/devices/cpu/spc700/spc700ds.cpp (BSD-3-Clause): each opcode from 00 to FF, its instruction and its
# two operands as MAME names them. MAME has NOT1 (EA) with no operand and DAA (DF) with none, which are NOT1 mem.bit
# (three bytes, as ares and Sony's manual have it) and DAA A.
